title: 第19章 三月之约第20章 蛮荒山脉
content_zh:
第19章三月之约
看台之上，鸦雀无声，如今在场众人，几乎都将视线看在生死台上的楚风眠身上。
他们都想看看，刚刚嚣张无比，将两位长老都没有放在眼中的楚风眠，到底会不会道歉。
“风眠，暂时道个歉，服个软吧，现在不是跟五长老冲突的时候，你的实力还太过弱小了些。”
听到林府府主的话，三长老的脸上露出几分喜色，急忙对着楚风眠耳边轻声说道。
如今道个歉，将来五长老就算是想要在为李星报仇，也没有一个好的理由。
“林叔，你不用说了。”
三长老看到楚风眠冷峻的表情，还想要在说下去，却是被楚风眠的一句话直接堵住。
楚风眠抬起头，看向那位于看台最高端的中年男子，一字一字的说道。
“我不会道歉！”
短短的五个字，几乎如同五声惊雷，响在众人的心中。
“狂妄！
真是狂妄至极！”
“这已经不是嚣张了！
这小子绝对是一个疯子！
疯狗！”
众人心中都在想着，但是不少林府弟子的心中，看向楚风眠的眼神，已经是带有些敬佩。
多少年了，只怕从林府建立开始，都机会无人敢反抗过林府府主的命令。
楚风眠的回答，甚至是就连林府府主的命令，都给拒绝。
“楚风眠，你！”

三长老在一旁急得要死，他没想到这样一个现成的台阶，只要是楚风眠退一步，就可以下去了。
可现在这一句话，更是将楚风眠推到了风口浪尖上。
“住嘴！”
“目中无人！”
“府主，这小子嚣张跋扈，就连您的命令都敢不听，这要嚣张之人，不能留他啊！”
“将他赶出林府！”
“不，废了他的修为！
把他贬为奴隶，去灰矿山挖矿！”
几乎是同时，无数声音响起，不止是四长老，五长老，就连二长老，执法长老也都是同时开口指责楚风眠起来。
在林府中，楚风眠的存在本就是一根刺，如今抓住机会，他们一个个都疯狂的喊了起来。
“事到如今，你们一个个也不用假惺惺的了。”
楚风眠看着那些咆哮的众人，嘴角露出几分冷笑道。
“这林府外府大管家的位置，是属于楚家的，跟你们林府也没有任何关系，楚某想要想要离开，自然就会离开，也用不着你们来赶。”
“五长老，你不是想要给李星报仇吗？楚某给你一个机会如何？”
楚风眠转过头去，看向五长老，突然开口道。
“三个月后，你我上生死台如何？”
上生死台！
三个月后，楚风眠又要上生死台。
而这一次楚风眠选择的目标，却是五长老。
“完了！

这小子真是疯了！”
“跟五长老上生死台？五长老可是锻体境的人物，这楚风眠难道是打算自杀？”
content_en:
Chapter 19 March Appointment
There was silence in the stands. Now almost everyone present had their eyes on Chu Fengmian on the stage of life and death.
They all wanted to see if Chu Fengmian, who had been so arrogant just now and ignored the two elders, would apologize.
"Feng Mian, please apologize for the time being and soften up. Now is not the time to conflict with the Fifth Elder. Your strength is still too weak."
Hearing the words of the Master of the Lin Mansion, the third elder's face showed a bit of joy, and he hurriedly whispered into Chu Fengmian's ear.
If you apologize now, even if the fifth elder wants to avenge Li Xing in the future, there will be no good reason.
"Uncle Lin, you don't need to say anything."
The third elder saw Chu Fengmian's stern expression and wanted to continue speaking, but was blocked by Chu Fengmian's words.
Chu Fengmian raised his head, looked at the middle-aged man at the top of the stand, and spoke word by word.
"I won't apologize!"
These five short words were almost like five thunders, ringing in everyone's hearts.
"Arrogant!
How arrogant! "
"This is no longer arrogant!
This guy is definitely a lunatic!
Mad dog! "
Everyone was thinking about this, but many Lin Mansion disciples looked at Chu Fengmian with some admiration in their eyes.
For how many years, even since the establishment of Lin Mansion, no one has dared to resist the orders of the master of Lin Mansion.
Chu Fengmian's answer and even the order from the master of the Lin Mansion were rejected.
"Chu Fengmian, you!"
The third elder was extremely anxious on the side. He did not expect such a ready-made step. As long as Chu Fengmian took a step back, he could go down.
But now this sentence has pushed Chu Fengmian to the forefront.
"Shut up!"
"Arrogant!"
"Master of the Palace, this boy is arrogant and domineering. He even dares to disobey your orders. This arrogant person cannot be left alone!"
"Kick him out of Lin Mansion!"
"No, ruin his cultivation!
Relegate him to slavery and dig in the gray mines! "
Almost at the same time, countless voices sounded. Not only the fourth elder, the fifth elder, but also the second elder and the law enforcement elder all started to accuse Chu Fengmian at the same time.
In the Lin Mansion, Chu Fengmian's existence was a thorn in the side, but now that they had seized the opportunity, they all shouted crazily.
"Now that things have happened, none of you need to be pretentious anymore."
Chu Fengmian looked at the roaring people with a sneer on his lips.
"The position of the chief steward of the Lin Mansion belongs to the Chu family and has nothing to do with your Lin Mansion. If Chu wants to leave, he will leave naturally, and there is no need for you to rush him."
"Fifth Elder, don't you want to avenge Li Xing? How about Chu giving you a chance?"
Chu Fengmian turned his head, looked at the fifth elder, and suddenly said.
"How about you and I go on the stage of life and death in three months?"
On the stage of life and death!
Three months later, Chu Fengmian will go to the stage of life and death again.
But this time, Chu Fengmian's target was the fifth elder.
"It's over!
This kid is really crazy! "
"Going to the stage of life and death with the fifth elder? The fifth elder is a figure in the body-forging realm. Is this Chu Fengmian planning to commit suicide?"
